name: PM Skills
summary: External product management skill marketplace from phuryn/pm-skills for discovery, PRD, GTM, positioning, validation framing, interview scripts, interview synthesis, and product decision support.

source.notes: Registered from https://github.com/phuryn/pm-skills. Relevant source paths include pm-product-discovery/skills/interview-script, pm-product-discovery/skills/summarize-interview, pm-product-discovery/skills/identify-assumptions-new, pm-product-discovery/skills/prioritize-assumptions, pm-product-discovery/skills/brainstorm-experiments-new, pm-product-strategy/skills/value-proposition, and pm-execution/skills/create-prd. Claude slash commands are not registered as Pipe commands by this entry.

useWhen: A product, validation, PRD, GTM, discovery, or positioning ticket needs structured product reasoning.
A ticket asks for upstream idea organization before execution.
A validation-planning ticket needs interview script generation, assumption mapping, experiment design, JTBD probing questions, or transcript synthesis.
A founder-facing pipeline step needs product discovery structure but the user should not be asked to choose skills, files, MCPs, or tools.
doNotUseWhen: The task is implementation-only and product scope is already fixed.
The output would be treated as customer evidence without source artifacts.
The task requires customer outreach, external communication, paid capability use, or private-source upload without explicit approval.
The task should be answered by a canonical Pipe policy, approval gate, Linear ticket, or repository artifact instead of an external PM framework.
routing.fallback: Use existing Pipe validation and product templates, then record missing product-skill coverage as a follow-up.

inputs.name: productQuestion
inputs.description: Specific product, discovery, PRD, GTM, or validation question.

outputs.name: productSynthesis
outputs.description: Structured product recommendation, assumptions, evidence needs, interview plan, synthesis, PRD input, or unresolved decisions.

schemas.notes: Future product-output schemas may normalize discovery and PRD outputs.

allowedOperations: Structure discovery, PRD, GTM, and validation outputs
Prepare customer interview scripts using PM Skills interview-script guidance
Summarize interview transcripts using PM Skills summarize-interview guidance
Map risky assumptions and validation experiments using PM Skills discovery guidance
forbiddenOperations: Approve product strategy without human review
Upload private interview material to external services
Install or vendor the entire PM Skills repository into Pipe without a dedicated ticket

cost.costDriver: Source is MIT-licensed, but runtime availability depends on installed skills, Claude plugin state, or copied skill folders.

risks.description: Product frameworks can sound like evidence even when no customer validation exists.
risks.mitigation: Separate assumptions, sources, and decisions; require source artifacts for claims.

approvalTriggers: Installing or updating external skill packages
Uploading private or customer interview material to any external service
Using paid PM Skills marketplace features if any are introduced
governance.dataBoundary: Use repository artifacts, founder-provided context, and approved interview summaries/transcripts only. Do not store or upload private evidence outside approved Pipe artifacts.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Do not convert product reasoning into legal, financial, clinical, compliance, or market-proof claims.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record assumptions, evidence gaps, and human decisions in the resulting artifact or Linear handoff.
governance.updatePolicy: Review when phuryn/pm-skills changes materially, when installed skill paths change, or after the first PIP-336 discovery use produces reusable learning.

review.reviewNotes: Pilot entry grounded in phuryn/pm-skills repository metadata and selected skill files. Use is approved for scoped Pipe discovery and validation planning, but PM Skills output remains product reasoning, not validation evidence.

examples.scenario: A ticket asks to refine an idea before PRD.
examples.expectedUse: Use PM Skills to structure assumptions, personas, validation questions, and MVP boundaries.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not claim PMF, demand, revenue, or customer commitment without evidence.

examples.scenario: A ticket asks for a five-interview discovery plan before code.
examples.expectedUse: Use PM Skills interview-script, assumption mapping, and experiment guidance internally, then output a Pipe-native interview plan with GO/NO-GO criteria.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not ask the founder to choose PM Skills manually, do not contact respondents, and do not treat the resulting script as evidence.

examples.scenario: A founder pastes an interview transcript for synthesis.
examples.expectedUse: Use PM Skills summarize-interview guidance with Pipe raw-evidence intake rules to extract JTBD, current solution, pains, pricing signals, contradictions, and next actions.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not upload transcripts to external services or promote raw notes into canonical customer evidence without the relevant approval and artifact boundary.
